module_title: History of Banking in India - Early Phases and Establishments
introduction: At this beginner level, we will trace the historical journey from the establishment of the very first banks by Europeans, the amalgamation of the Presidency Banks, and the birth of the 'State Bank of India' (SBI).

core_concepts.title: The First Bank of India
core_concepts.description: The first bank to be established in India was the 'Bank of Hindustan', founded in 1770 in Calcutta under European management. However, it eventually failed and was liquidated.

core_concepts.title: Early Indian Managed Banks
core_concepts.description:
1. Oudh Commercial Bank (1881): The first bank with 'Limited Liability' managed by Indians. 
2. Punjab National Bank (PNB - 1894): The first bank 'purely managed by Indians' (Lala Lajpat Rai played a pivotal role in its establishment).

core_concepts.title: Imperial Bank of India
core_concepts.description: During the British era, there were three major 'Presidency Banks': Bank of Bengal (1806), Bank of Bombay (1840), and Bank of Madras (1843). In 1921, these three were merged to form a single massive entity called the 'Imperial Bank of India'.

core_concepts.title: Birth of SBI
core_concepts.description: Post-independence, on the recommendation of the 'A.D. Gorwala Committee' (All India Rural Credit Survey Committee), the Imperial Bank of India was nationalized on July 1, 1955, and renamed the 'State Bank of India' (SBI).

important_entities.name: Nationalization of the RBI
important_entities.significance: The Reserve Bank of India (RBI) was originally established in 1935 as a private shareholders' bank. To gain complete control over the monetary system post-independence, the Government of India 'nationalized' the RBI on January 1, 1949.

trap_alerts_and_exceptions.explanation: A common exam trap: If a question asks for the 'First Indian Bank (with wholly Indian capital and management)', the answer is 'Central Bank of India' (established in 1911), often called the first truly Swadeshi bank. If it asks for the first Indian *managed* bank, it is PNB (1894).

mnemonics_and_tricks.explanation: Bengal, Bombay, Madras (BBM) merged to form the Imperial Bank of India (IBI) in 1921, which became the State Bank of India (SBI) in 1955.

exam_strategy_tips: The establishment year of SBI (1955) and the nationalization year of RBI (1949) are all-time favorite questions in SSC and Railway exams.
